Sounds like you have a lot of reasons to not do exercises.

I'd say your biggest need right now is to find a reason to do exercises. Otherwise problems like "it hurts after 25 minutes" will stop you from doing it for 20 and "I was never good" will stop you from getting better. There are a hundred things you could try, but until you can react to imperfection with a willingness to keep at it and adjust things, you will quit them all.

For the sore knees, see a physiotherapist and try foam rolling.

Calisthenics in a circuit for 30 minutes will get your heart going. All the classics like push-ups, squats, lunges, sit ups, jumping jacks, planks, reverse crunches, glute bridges, burpees, etc. And the jump rope.

And I suggest you try yoga. It's simple to start out and there are videos on YouTube. It's a good full body workout.
You can try doing some HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) at home. Here is an example of stuff you could do.
